Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Suryakant Maithani, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. Ashish Joshi, Advocate for the Bank.
2. Petitioner is serving as Law Officer in Bank 
of Baroda. He has been transferred from 
Regional Office, Dehradun to Rudrapur Region 
vide order dated 01.06.2026.
3. It is contended that on 20.05.2026, 
petitioner was transferred from Dehradun to 
Jalandhar with relieving date of 30.05.2026 but 
he was not relieved and thereafter on 01.06.2026, 
another order was passed, which is impugned in 
this petition. Thus, it is contended that it is a case 
of malicious transfer. 
4. Let counter affidavit be filed within four 
weeks.
5. List on 18.08.2026. 6. Till next date of listing, impugned order 
dated 01.06.2026 shall remain stayed.
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 29.06.2026 Mahinder/
